description: This file defines the EmployeeGender class, which implements Stringable to represent an employee's gender as a string based on an internal integer gender code. It is part of the reporting/display logic within the HRM system, specifically for personal report fields.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: Represents an employee's gender as a string, based on an internal integer code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeGender object with a nullable integer gender code.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the gender as a string ('Male', 'Female', 'Other') based on internal code, or null if unspecified.
